Does Brad Pitt die in The Dark Side of the Sun?

He plays Rick Clayton.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

Yes. He takes off the mask, feels the sun, and lets the disease win.

Rick has a rare skin disease that makes any light lethal, so he lives in a full leather suit and mask. After a Yugoslav healer fails and the actress he loves rejects his unmasked face, Rick decides to stop hiding: he strips off the protection and feels sunlight on his skin for the first time. The disease then takes its course, and his father accepts the choice he made.

Pitt's first lead. Shot in 1988 in Yugoslavia, unreleased until 1997. The death is implied rather than shown as a drawn-out scene.
